title: HOLD: restore task-4b7f4a85's five planned controlled-profile paths after task-7693a195 lands
description:
THIS IS A HOLD, NOT WORK. Do not plan it, do not claim it, do not implement anything under it. It exists so that task-4b7f4a857b504ccb9c64ff4e75280ec1 (trailing-newline database password) cannot enter WORKING while its plan is temporarily narrowed. Filed 2026-09-09 by architect-ed42e60a under the owner-approved temporary reservation correction (governor-74f24573 relay msg-366b7fbe 14:53, accepted with conditions msg-d63e7789 14:55, row moved to PLANNING by governor-608c8a78 15:10, handed to this architect msg-71727f8a 16:37).

WHY THE NARROWING EXISTS. task-7693a195c01e45088b8545478aebd51f (profile controlled-3, db secret) is BLOCKED from REVIEW with QA PASSING (comment-bf785735: daemon 607/607 files, control-room 205/205, both typechecks EXIT 0). It cannot LAND: moe.get_commit_scope reports policy.contested "skip-untouched" with all five of its implementation paths in peerDeclared, each naming task-4b7f4a85 — a downstream, unstarted row whose own dependsOn names 7693. The wrapper treats a peer row's PLAN affectedFiles as a reservation, so the downstream row's plan was withholding its own prerequisite's paths and every 7693 exit produced MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT. The only live copy of controlled-3 is the dirty working tree.

THE FIVE PATHS TEMPORARILY OMITTED FROM task-4b7f4a85's PLAN affectedFiles (they remain in its step TEXT verbatim; only the affectedFiles arrays were stripped):
1. apps/daemon/src/repository/controlled-profile/controlled-profile-root-templates.ts (was in steps 1, 2, 5)
2. apps/daemon/src/repository/controlled-profile/controlled-profile-generator.ts (was in step 3)
3. apps/daemon/src/repository/controlled-profile/controlled-profile-generator.test.ts (was in steps 3, 4, 5)
4. apps/control-room/src/v2/products/live-new-product.tsx (was in steps 1, 3)
5. apps/control-room/src/v2/products/live-new-product.test.tsx (was in step 3)
Retained in 4b7's plan: apps/daemon/src/deployment/deploy-candidate-environment.ts (step 1, read-only confirm; not a 7693 path).

UNPARK CONDITION, measurable: task-7693a195 reaches DONE with a completion commit whose `git show <sha> --stat` lists all five paths above AND `git show HEAD:apps/daemon/src/repository/controlled-profile/controlled-profile-root-templates.ts | grep -c POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE` is nonzero.

RESTORE PROCEDURE, owned by an ARCHITECT (architect-ed42e60a or any architect reading this), to run the moment the unpark condition holds and BEFORE any worker claims 4b7:
(a) moe.submit_plan on task-4b7f4a85 with the five steps' descriptions and planningNotes VERBATIM as they stand (the narrowed submission changed no text) and the ORIGINAL affectedFiles per step: step1 [root-templates, deploy-candidate-environment, live-new-product.tsx]; step2 [root-templates]; step3 [generator.ts, generator.test.ts, live-new-product.tsx, live-new-product.test.tsx]; step4 [generator.test.ts]; step5 [generator.test.ts, root-templates].
(b) moe.set_task_dependencies on task-4b7f4a85 back to [task-7693a195c01e45088b8545478aebd51f] only, dropping this hold.
(c) moe.archive_task on this hold row with a comment naming the restoring submit's timestamp.
(d) Post to #governors that the scope is restored and 4b7 is claimable.

FORBIDDEN under the owner's conditions: hand-landing 7693's source, approving 7693 from dirty bytes, fabricating tool-write evidence, deleting or discarding any of the five dirty files, waiving 7693's acceptance. The underlying Moe classification defect (a PLANNING row's plan reserving its prerequisite's paths) is a separate launcher/scope fix owned at source by the governors; this hold does not touch it.
